_comment: The email-masking contract, shared by the only two implementations that are
allowed to exist: redact.Email (Go, this package) and maskEmail
(web/src/lib/pii.ts). C11 found three implementations of this function and
the point of consolidating was that two of them could drift without anyone
noticing — one Go copy is now gone, and this file is what stops the two
remaining ones diverging. Both languages' tests read it, so a change to the
rule has to be made here first and then fails on whichever side did not
Every address is in an RFC 2606 example domain: no fixture, test output or CI
log in this repository may carry an address that could belong to a person.

cases.why: the ordinary case: first local character and the whole domain survive
case is preserved, because the domain is what an operator reads
trimmed: a value out of a form or a header carries whitespace
a one-character local part has nothing to keep — showing it would show all of it
the last @ wins, because a local part may contain a quoted one and a domain may not
not an address: fully masked rather than echoed, since the input could be a token
no local part is not an address
no domain is not an address
empty stays empty, so an absent field does not become a masked one
whitespace only is an absent field
idempotent: the same value can pass the masker at the call site and again in the logger
